scope.description: Whole OpenSees useful structural/geotechnical analysis breadth.
scope.denominator: Geometry/constraints, truss/frame/shell/solid elements, elastic/inelastic materials, static/nonlinear/dynamic/seismic/geotechnical analysis, response evaluation and reliability.

coverage.rationale: A complete bounded general planar elastic truss product covers editable structural networks, redundant mixed stiffness, signed nodal load response and measured serviceability decisions. Most OpenSees element/material and nonlinear/dynamic/geotechnical families remain explicitly excluded.

scope.description: Planar pin-jointed small-strain elastic truss serviceability from node/member/load/measurement intent.
scope.denominator: Physical network decisions, semantic stability checks, isolated native construction, independent numerical verification, accountable measured requirements and durable workflow publications within the declared product.

abstraction.rationale: Users author engineering geometry, Cartesian restraints, E/area, signed loads and named measured limits. The adaptor supplies solver construction, numbering, linear solution, native readback, independent direct stiffness/equilibrium, reconstruction and CSV/assessment handoff. General design optimisation and code compliance remain excluded.

limitations: Small supported subset of a much larger structural/geotechnical application; no frame/solid/3D, nonlinear, buckling, plastic, transient, seismic or safety-certification claim.
Native acceptance covers named serial fixtures and observed pinned engine/package; it does not establish arbitrary structure safety, MPI or exhaustive continuous-domain correctness.
Subjective editorial whole-application and declared-workflow scores, separate from native qualification and runtime availability.
